Eastern Cape Province, South Africa | Severe thunderstorm with heavy rain and hail caused flooding and property damage in several towns.

Vrondados, Chios, Greece | Sudden hailstorm devastated citrus orchards. Intense rain turned streets into torrents, emergency pumping carried out.
